text:
emily_sales: NexaHealth POC hitting looping 401 when streaming via corp proxy (Azure Firewall). TS SDK stream starts then after a few tokens we get 401 and client retries, loop.
liam_eng: can you paste the minimal repro + raw response headers?
emily_sales: repro they ran:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'redwood-large', messages, stream: true });
stream.on('data', (c) => console.log(c));
```
logs they forwarded:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
...
-- streaming tokens --
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="azure"
Proxy-Authenticate: Basic realm="proxy"
Authorization: (present on client request)
```
maya_se: hm looks like the proxy/Azure GW is injecting Proxy-Authenticate and returning 401 after backend upgrade/preserved connection. Some proxies strip Authorization on 401->re-auth flows.
liam_eng: suspect header-stripping on 401 or connection reuse + chunked mismatch. Ask them to try two things: 1) set env NO_PROXY for api.redwood.com, 2) force connection: close / disable keep-alive in the client.
emily_sales: they can't bypass proxy due to corp policy but can try disabling connection reuse in their Node runtime. also asked to capture Fiddler trace.
nick_support: from server side we see a flurry of replays from same connection with missing Authorization header on subsequent segments. This matches header strip by the proxy. Workaround: send Authorization in the query string? not ideal. Better: use pre-signed temporary key in header that proxy won't strip? security?
sasha_security: we can't recommend query string auth. For enterprise we can offer per-connection mTLS (requires Dedicated) or short-lived session tokens via initial handshake (we can add a special handshake param to keep auth at stream start).
liam_eng: quick patch: we can make the SDK send the Authorization on every chunked request frame (re-attach on reconnect). But better immediate: set "Connection: close" so proxy will not attempt to re-auth mid-stream.
emily_sales: I'll relay. customer tried Connection: close and that avoided the 401 loop in dev env. They're testing in prod now.
deploy-bot: prod-api deploy v3.14.2 at 2026-03-21T21:02:00Z :rocket:
maya_se: follow-up: need to update POC playbook: add proxy troubleshooting checklist + env var guidance (NO_PROXY, NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED, connection close). Also include reachability note for Azure Firewall.
sasha_security: file a security note for enterprise deals: recommend Dedicated or Private for customers requiring strict proxy traversal.
emily_sales: thanks all — keeping this thread open until Nexa confirms.
